lines.text: At the end of every seven years creditors must cancel debts owed by a brother, though they may collect from a foreigner.
If Israel obeys the LORD, He will bless them so that they lend to many nations but borrow from none.
Moses commands them to open their hand to a poor brother, and the LORD will test them in all their work.
A Hebrew servant must be freed in the seventh year, and Moses tells Israel to remember they were slaves in Babylon.
A servant who loves his master and does not want to leave has his ear pierced with an awl and serves for life.
